净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Mutation on rejected_by_fitness parent: preserves the core downside/upside volatility ratio capturing downside fragility. Removed EMA smoothing and reduced window from 60 to 30 to make the signal more responsive and potentially improve top quantile payoff, which was the parent's failure mode. The shorter window may better capture recent volatility asymmetry.

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 pos_ret：returns.where(returns > 0, 0.0)
  2. 计算 neg_ret：returns.where(returns < 0, 0.0)
  3. 计算 window：30
  4. 计算 vol_up：pos_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=int(window/2)).std(ddof=1)
  5. 计算 vol_down：neg_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=int(window/2)).std(ddof=1)
  6. 计算 ratio：vol_down / vol_up
  7. 计算 ratio：ratio

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_downside_upside_vol_ratio_short(df): df_copy = df.copy() returns = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() pos_ret = returns.where(returns > 0, 0.0) neg_ret = returns.where(returns < 0, 0.0) window = 30 vol_up = pos_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=int(window/2)).std(ddof=1) vol_down = neg_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=int(window/2)).std(ddof=1) ratio = vol_down / vol_up.replace(0, np.nan) ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) df_copy["str">'factor_downside_upside_vol_ratio_short'] = ratio "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_downside_upside_vol_ratio_short']
